results.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to let White House ballroom construction continue during appeal
results.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump’s administration on Friday asked the U.S. Supreme Court to allow the White House to continue construction on its $400 million ballroom project while it appeals a lower court’s order to halt the work.

results.title: 2007 Nissan 350Z Touring Roadster 6-Speed at No Reserve
results.description: This 2007 Nissan 350Z Touring roadster has 61k miles following registration history in Maryland since new. Finished in Magnetic Black Pearl with a black soft top, the car is powered by a 3.5-liter V6 linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. It rolls on 18" five-spoke alloy wheels and is further equipped with a Bassani cat-back exhaust system, bi-xenon headlights, and a shorty antenna. Inside, the heated power-adjustable seats are trimmed in Charcoal leather and complemented by automatic climate control, cruise control, an in-dash CD changer, a Bose audio system, and navigation. Recently acquired by the selling dealer, this 350Z is now offered at no reserve with manufacturer's literature, two key fobs, a clean Carfax report, and a clean Maryland title.
